perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

enhanced.name: Danger Zone
enhanced.description:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

enhanced.name: Quickdraw
enhanced.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion

enhanced.name: Perpetual Motion

enhanced.name: Strategist

perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

enhanced.name: Deconstruct
enhanced.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
